At Kamalia Khaddar, a premium sooti khaddar crafted by revitalizing the primal concept of homespun weaving and enhancing it with modern textile technology. Woven on state-of-the-art looms, combines the distinctive character of traditional Khaddar with an exceptionally soft, smooth, lightweight, and comfortable finish. Khaddi Live ’26 is an exclusive Kamalia Khaddar creation, available only through our authorized outlets across Pakistan and our official online store, with free delivery.
•	Fabric: Premium Sooti Khaddar
•	Season: Lightweight Winter
•	Feel: Exceptionally Soft & Smooth
•	Comfort: Breathable & Skin-Friendly
•	Length: 7 Meters & Width: 1 Yard
